text: What's the best parenting schedule for your child's age? Here's a quick guide from Pullos Lawyers. Since May 2024, there's no legal starting point favouring equal time. The focus is the best interests of the child. Babies and toddlers may benefit from short, frequent time with each parent. Preschool children still rely heavily on routine and reassurance. For primary school children, arrangements should support their everyday life, not disrupt it. And for teenagers, flexibility becomes increasingly important. If you're working out a parenting schedule, our team can help. Speak with Pullos Lawyers.
